{{Top}}
[[File:Robo-bartender-FF57.png|thumb|Robo-Bartender]]
A '''bartender droid''', '''robo-bartender''',<ref name="HSR">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> '''robotender''',<ref name="OSS">{{WEGCite|story=The Other Side of the Story|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters}}</ref> or '''mixicologist droid'''<ref name="GTLAA">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref> was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed to serve in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and bars. One worked at [[Leatherback's]] on [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], but the owner had to get rid of it when the droid-hating [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded.<ref name="Last Call at Leatherback's">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20020221a2|text=Last Call at Leatherback's|int=Last Call at Leatherback's}}</ref> Some bartender droids were simply repurposed droids of other types -- famously, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] aboard the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] and the [[Unidentified bartender droid|modified protocol droids]] at the [[Cluster]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].

[[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] produced the [[MixRMastR]] model,<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> while another model was the [[LeisureMech Enterprises/Legends|LeisureMech Enterprises]] [[C5 bartender droid/Legends|C5 bartender droid]].
